simple.meaning: מִקְדָּשׁ (miqdâsh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a consecrated thing or place, especially, a palace , sanctuary (whether of Jehovah or of idols) or asylum.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 74 times across Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Joshua, 1 Chronicles, and 9 more, beginning at Exodus 15:17. Its contexts include family line, altar, blood, priesthood, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִקְדָּשׁ (H4720).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מִקְדָּשׁ (miqdâsh) / H4720 is traced through Exodus 15:17, Exodus 25:8, Leviticus 12:4, Leviticus 16:33 as a generated source-based concept entry.

“ ‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am Yahweh.
I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.

Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.
The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.

Out of all your gifts, you shall offer every wave offering to Yahweh, of all its best parts, even the holy part of it.’

Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of Yahweh.

Now set your heart and your soul to follow Yahweh your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of Yahweh God, to bring the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for Yahweh’s name.”
Take heed now; for Yahweh has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”
They lived in it, and have built you a sanctuary in it for your name, saying,

definitions.full: H4720. miqdash or miqqedash מִקְדָּשׁ noun masculine Amos 7:9 sacred place, sanctuary ; — ׳מ Exod 25:8 +; מִקְּדָשׁ 15:17 (Ges § 20h Kö ii. 1, 471 ); construct מִקְדַּשׁ Lev 16:33 +; suffix מִקְדָּשִׁי 20:3 +, etc., מִקְדְּשׁוֺ Num 18:29 (Kö ii. 1, 97 ); plural מִקְדָּשִׁים Ezek 21:7 , construct מִקְדְּשֵׁי Jer 51:51 2 t.; suffix מִקְדָּשַׁי Lev 21:23 ; מְקַדְשֵׁיהֶם Ezek 7:24 (on anomalous pointing see Ew § 215 a Hi-Sm; but probably Pi`el Participle was in mind, Ges § 93oo Anm.; < read מִקְדְּשֵׁיהֶם ); etc.; — 1 old Israel sanctuaries: of ׳י at Shechem Josh 24:26 (E); probably also Exod 15:17 (i.e. Shiloh); plural of sanct. to be destroyed by ׳י Lev 26:31 (H); יִשׂ ׳מִקְדְּשֵׁי in Northern Israel Amos 7:9 ; מִקְדַּשׁמֶֿלֶךְ vAmos 7:13 (Bethel). 2 of the nations: Moab Isa 16:12 plural of Tyre Ezek 28:18 (Co Toy [not Berthol Krae] read קָדְשְׁךָ thy sanctity ). 3 tabernacle and its precincts Exod 25:8 (P) +; הַקֹּדֶשׁ מִקְדַּשׁ Lev 16:33 , plural 21:23 . 4 temple and precincts 1Chr 22:19 ; Isa 63:18 ; Psa 74:7 +; מִקְדָּשָׁם בֵּית 2Chr 36:17 , הבית מקדשׁ Ezek 48:21 , מ ׳מְכוֺן Dan 8:11 ; plural of many sacred places in and about the temple. י בית ׳מִקְדְּשֵׁי Jer 51:51 ; אֵל מִקְדְּשֵׁי Psa 73:17 .
